messages:
Lina Tran: FYI autopay for BrightGrid (acct_BG-77) failed on INV-2145 ($9,400). Gateway returned expired_card. Need a quick ops plan: retry schedule, hosted payment link, or short grace?

Javier Morales: pulled gateway logs, response:
```json
{"status":"failed","error":{"type":"card_error","code":"card_declined","decline_code":"expired_card","message":"Card has expired"},"payment_method":"pm_2Kz...","customer":"cus_M7p..."}
```

Priya Nair: reached out to the customer. They say the stewarding finance person is out until EOD but they have a replacement card. Asked if we can provide a secure one-time payment link and a 48-hour grace period.

Sam O'Leary: short answer: yes to pay link. Finance needs to OK 48h grace and whether to apply a small service hold to prevent throttling.

billing-bot: Autopay retry policy: next retry in 24h (2 attempts left). Dunning emails scheduled per default cadence.

Javier Morales: Suggestion: pause automated retries/dunning to avoid multiple customer emails, generate single-use hosted payment page (no CVV retention), and we can provision a $1,000 temporary credit to avoid service disruption while they update card. Manual capture only after link payment confirmed.

Lina Tran: Approve $1k temporary credit for BrightGrid and a 48-hour due date extension. Waive auto late fee for this invoice only. Pause dunning while CS engages.

Priya Nair: Customer attempted the 3DS flow but it failed with auth_required. They asked if we can accept the card by phone to bypass 3DS — legal says we can't store CVV or enter raw card details into the portal. We'll resend the hosted link and advise use of their issuing bank's 3DS step or try the new virtual card.

Stripe Connector: Payment intent created: pi_3Lx... awaiting confirmation. Hosted payment url: https://pay.redwood.com/t/GT99 (expires 72h, single-use).

Sam O'Leary: Finance OK on hosted link only. @billing-bot please mark INV-2145: hold=awaiting_payment_update, suppress_dunning=true.

billing-bot: INV-2145 flagged: hold=awaiting_payment_update; dunning suppressed; autopay retries paused.

Javier Morales: Link sent and CRM updated. I'll schedule reminder to attempt manual collect only after payment settles.

Lina Tran: Recap: CS (Priya) handle customer instructions and confirm when payment completes; Finance (Javier) created link and authorized $1k temporary credit and +48h due date. Leave thread open until payment posts. :white_check_mark:

Priya Nair: Customer confirmed they'll try again this afternoon and will escalate to their payments team if 3DS blocks. I'll post an update here when received.

Javier Morales: Noted. Will revert invoice state and remove hold once payment settles.

Lina Tran: Thanks team.
